studio.A1_studio_before_carving_water_under_the: River: click the ground to start a river, upstream first; each click adds a point downstream; Enter finishes. Click a river to select it, drag its posts to move points. Insert adds a point, Delete removes one, Esc cancels.
studio.A2_studio_bed_carved: River 'brook': its bed carved, a quarter of its width deep in the middle. Undo puts the ground back.
studio.A3_studio_plants_cleared: River 'brook': the scattered plants and rocks in its water taken away.
studio.A4_studio_drawn_over_the_ground: River 'river' added (3 points). Drag its posts to shape it.
studio.A5_studio_drawn_river_carved_lies_in_its: River 'river': its bed carved, a quarter of its width deep in the middle. Undo puts the ground back.
